title: Grateful Dead Live at Compton Terrace Amphitheatre on 1980-06-05
source: (FOB) Sony ECM-990 stereo microphone > Cassette Master (Marantz Superscope CD320/Maxell UDXLI) Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Korg MR-1000 (1-bit/5.6MHz) > Audiogate (1-bit/5.6MHz > 24-bit/96KHz) > Soundforge 9.0 (edits) Recorded FOB by Bob Morris. Transfer (Jul 09) and 24/96 edit/patch (Dec 09) by Bob Morris.

ai_review.summary: Audience tape from Morris with surprisingly clear sound, but reviewers are split on the show's quality.
ai_review.review: One reviewer calls this Morris audience recording a pleasant surprise and says it sounds good, while another finds the performance boring and substandard. No specific songs or band moments are mentioned, leaving the musical content largely uncharacterized.

ai_rating.rationale: Two reviews give a high (5) and moderate (3) rating; average suggests a solid show with decent recording, but limited commentary reduces certainty.
